description: Direct detector patch was tested but is not accepted: classsep_regression remains PASS 17/17 with 10/10 controls, while full audit_evidence reports 21 hard findings and detects frozen artifact drift in research_map/class_separation.py (previous c266dbceca87, current e36b0d644ca). The patch increased metalinguistic false positives and cannot bind a gate.
needed_to_unblock: Audit lead must freeze writers, restore or formally re-freeze detector with before/after hashes, add explicit meta-audit fixtures to the regression corpus, run classsep regression plus full audit, and obtain two independent reviews on unchanged detector and formulation hashes.
next_falsifier: A pinned replay still reports quoted false-positive prose as a genuine merge, or a genuine merge fixture is missed after the accepted detector revision.
